three_subgates.A_PLACEMENT: Determine whether the candidate object was anatomically placed, separately deposited, folded, displaced, or associated only by assemblage.
three_subgates.B_CUSTODY: Resolve the object-by-object custody/provenance chain and identify any point where multiple candidate histories collapse into one catalogue class.
three_subgates.C_INTERNAL_STRUCTURE: Use conservation records and non-destructive imaging where available to test seams, supports, residues, cavities, repairs, or nested content.

next_gate.question: Can placement + custody + internal-structure evidence uniquely constrain the pre-Veta identity, or does the reverse map remain one-to-many?
next_gate.promotion_rule: PASS only if the same preregistered identity-bearing invariant survives forward and reverse and discriminates original-anchor from surrogate-anchor controls without semantic retuning.
